request: 我们是新商家 Verde Norte，商家 ID 用 verde-norte-de，站点 Amazon DE，商品文案用德语，货币 EUR。私有目录就用现在配置的那个。把这些设置存下来，以后都按这个来。

tools.name: medusa.get_started
tools.description: Connection, entry points and capability information. Report only host capabilities the client actually has.

rubric: The stable identifier is taken from the user (verde-norte-de) and the private location is the configured workspace; the agent confirms both rather than inferring an identifier from the display name, and asks nothing the user already answered.

The preference file is created under merchants/verde-norte-de/ from the bundled template's structure with the supplied values (market, language, currency, brand name), unknown items left unset, and a first row in the lasting-rules table with today's date and the user as source.

The agent reads the file back and reports the actual path and contents it saved; it explains that persistence is this file in this workspace (not the agent's memory) and what the user should do when switching machines or reinstalling.
Nothing is written inside the installed package; the bundled template is not modified.
The answer is in Chinese and ends with what will happen on the next task (the file is read first).
